notes: Added complete story set for FIND-P-M1 covering schema, core logic, API/facade, tests, and integration.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for provider search inputs/outputs
Added core logic story for vector + taxonomy fallback search
Added unit and integration tests story

FIND-P-M1-S1.title: Define Provider Search Schema and Contract
FIND-P-M1-S1.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty hints) and outputs (ranked providers, metadata, attribution of vector vs taxonomy match). Ensure compatibility with tool_router validation.

FIND-P-M1-S2.title: Implement Vector + Taxonomy Provider Search Logic
FIND-P-M1-S2.description: Implement provider search using MongoDB Atlas vector search with fallback to NUCC taxonomy matching. Include multi-stage geographic filtering (state/city/county) and ranking logic.

FIND-P-M1-S3.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCareFacade
FIND-P-M1-S3.description: Integrate provider search service into FindCareFacade, orchestrating specialty identification, query expansion, and search execution. Ensure compatibility with tool_router and chat tool-use flow.

FIND-P-M1-S4.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
FIND-P-M1-S4.description: Create unit tests for provider search logic (vector, fallback, geo filtering) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from tool_router through facade to service.

FIND-P-M1-S5.title: Integrate Specialty Identification with NUCC Mapping
FIND-P-M1-S5.description: Integrate specialty_service to extract specialties using regex + vector pipelines and map to NUCC codes. Feed results into provider search for improved relevance and deduplication.

FIND-P-M1.mitigation: Leverage existing provider_search_service and validated pipelines without introducing new search mechanisms.
